item.title: Affirmations to Confidence with Joshua Watkis — Tue Dec 1, 3:30 PM — Dufferin/St.Clair
item.description:
In this workshop, Coach Joshua Watkis will address the self-scrutiny faced by youth in the digital age by using poetry and self-reflection as tools for positive reinforcement. Participants will learn how to identify, affirm, and articulate their intrinsic value by mastering the basics of metaphors and similes and utilizing the psychological and poetic power of targeted repetition and group affirmations. item.title: Toma mejores decisiones con Copilot: de la información a la acción — Fri Dec 4, 4:00 PM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto En esta sesión práctica aprenderemos a utilizar Microsoft Copilot como apoyo para estructurar y analizar decisiones, construyendo juntos un framework sencillo que nos permita evaluar alternativas de manera más clara y consciente.
Trabajaremos con seis elementos: problema, evidencia, alternativas, criterios, riesgos y recomendación. A través de ejemplos y demostraciones en vivo, utilizaremos Copilot para organizar información, comparar opciones, identificar supuestos y explorar riesgos antes de tomar una decisión.
El objetivo no es que Copilot decida por nosotros, sino aprender una metodología que nos permita analizar, cuestionar y tomar decisiones mejor informadas manteniendo el criterio y la responsabilidad humana.
Source: Meetup: Microsoft Reactor Toronto

item.description: Respiratory illnesses like respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and influenza (the flu) are common, but knowing how to protect yourself and your family, recognize symptoms, and decide when to seek medical care isn't always straightforward. Join Ilham Elias, Primary Care Nurse Practitioner with St. Joseph’s Health Centre and Urban Family Health Team, for an informative session on preventing RSV and the flu, understanding vaccination eligibility, and recognizing when symptoms may require medical attention. What to Expect Understanding RSV and Flu: Learn about these respiratory illnesses and why prevention matters. Prevention and Vaccination: Explore ways to reduce the risk of RSV and flu, including who may be eligible for vaccination. Recognizing Symptoms: Learn how to distinguish between common, expected symptoms and warning signs that may indicate a more serious illness. item.title: Humber Heritage Walk! — Sat Dec 12, 10:30 AM — Feet First Foot Clinic
item.description: Join us for the Humber Heritage Walk! Discover the stories, history and natural beauty of our neighbourhood! Join local nature expert and photographer Richard Bod for a guided community walk exploring the scenic Humber River and the historic charm of Old Mill! Along the way, uncover fascinating local stories, admire architectural treasures and learn about the area’s natural environment and wildlife, including the spectacular annual salmon run. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, nature lover or simply enjoy exploring your community, this is a wonderful opportunity to get moving, connect with others and discover a little more about the place we call home. Presented by Feet First Clinic, featuring local nature expert and photographer Richard Bod. The walking tour begins and concludes in Bloor West Village.
